data.name: Aurang
data.gender_notes: Aurang is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aurang means 'dawn' or 'glow' or 'radiant'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'al-aur' which means 'dawn'. This name is associated with the beauty and majesty of the dawn and is often given to boys to inspire a sense of strength and wisdom in them. The name Aurang carries the meaning “dawn, glow, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Aurang usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, glow, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aurang is a spiritual name that symbolizes the beauty and majesty of the dawn. It is a reminder of the divine light that illuminates the world and guides us on our spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Aurang belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “dawn, glow, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aurang total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
